mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallets WHERE user_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallets (user_id, balance, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, 0.00, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE wallets SET balance = balance + #{amount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND #{amount} > 0
UPDATE wallets SET balance = balance - #{amount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND balance >= #{amount} AND #{amount} > 0
